reader1.note: Tree-sitter pass yields NodeInfo(kind,name,line_start,line_end,...) stored one row per symbol in the nodes table.

reader2.note: Tree-sitter parser emits NodeInfo (kind, name, line_start, line_end, file) stored in the nodes table.

reader1.note: Extension/shebang table maps dozens of languages to tree-sitter grammars, with custom extractors (Vue, Svelte, notebooks, VB.NET, SQL, ReScript).

reader2.note: Extension map dispatches dozens of languages to per-language extractors in the parser.

reader1.note: nodes table has params, return_type and docstring columns filled by the parser.

reader2.note: nodes table keeps params, return_type and docstring filled by the parser.

reader1.note: Parser fills a stored modifiers field, but no query or output reads it (grep modifiers outside parser.py/graph.py persistence found nothing).

reader2.note: modifiers column is set by the parser and stored, but GraphNode and tools never read or output it.

reader1.note: is_test column set from path/name rules and decorators, plus TESTED_BY edges, filtered in communities and dead-code.

reader2.note: Naming/path/decorator rules set nodes.is_test, create TESTED_BY edges, and are filtered on in queries (tests_for).

reader1.note: CALLS edges stored in the edges table; query_graph patterns callers_of/callees_of read both directions.

reader2.note: CALLS edges stored and queried via callers_of/callees_of.

reader1.note: IMPORTS_FROM edges between files/modules are stored in edges and queried (file_summary, impact).

reader2.note: IMPORTS_FROM edges stored; imports_of/importers_of patterns read them.

reader1.note: INHERITS and IMPLEMENTS edges stored; query_graph has inheritors_of.

reader2.note: INHERITS and IMPLEMENTS edges stored; inheritors_of pattern reads them.

reader1.note: Post-parse resolvers (scoped, Python import, tsconfig, jedi, spring) link bare call targets to definitions in other files using imports and scope.

reader2.note: Post-parse resolvers bind bare call targets using imports, scope, receiver evidence, jedi and tsconfig paths.

reader1.note: Leiden (igraph) with file-based fallback, stored in communities table with generated names.

reader2.note: Leiden via igraph (optional dependency) with file-based fallback; named communities stored in communities table.

reader1.note: REFERENCES edges (function-as-value, exports, HCL variable refs, qualifier references) and DEPENDS_ON are stored; type-use coverage varies by language.

reader2.note: REFERENCES edges for type and value references stored; references_to pattern reads them.

reader1.note: nodes_fts FTS5 index with column weights queried by hybrid_search and the search command.

reader2.note: FTS5 nodes_fts with BM25 ranking queried by hybrid_search / semantic_search_nodes.

reader1.note: Node embeddings (local/Google/OpenAI/Voyage providers) with cosine nearest-neighbour search, merged into hybrid_search by RRF.

reader2.note: Node embeddings (local, Google, OpenAI, Voyage, MiniMax) stored and searched by cosine, merged with FTS via RRF; needs embed_graph run.

reader1.note: LIKE substring keyword fallback plus camelCase name_tokens in FTS; no edit-distance.

reader2.note: Camel-case token splitting, FTS prefix terms and LIKE substring fallback with exact/prefix/contains scoring; no edit distance.

reader1.searched: grep in code_review_graph/*.py and tools/: re.compile on user query, regex, ast-grep, structural pattern, fnmatch in tools/query.py, search.py, tools/
reader1.note: query_graph patterns are fixed relation names (callers_of, ...) and find_large_functions takes a path substring; no regex or syntax-pattern search over code.

reader2.searched: grep -rn -i 'regex|ast-grep|re.compile(pattern|grep' in tools/query.py, main.py, search.py; query_graph _QUERY_PATTERNS list
reader2.note: query_graph takes named graph patterns (callers_of etc.), not a regex or syntax pattern over code.

reader1.note: serve command starts a FastMCP server (stdio or --http) exposing ~30 tools.

reader2.note: `serve` runs a FastMCP stdio (or HTTP) server exposing ~30 tools.

reader1.note: argparse subparsers include build, update, query, impact, search, watch, status, visualize, detect-changes and more.

reader2.note: argparse subcommands build, update, watch, query, search, impact, detect-changes, visualize and more print results.

reader1.note: serve --http listens on localhost:5555 for MCP over Streamable HTTP (needs the flag); visualize writes a self-contained d3 HTML view.

reader2.note: `serve --http` listens for MCP over Streamable HTTP on localhost and `visualize --serve` serves an interactive view.

reader1.note: install writes MCP configs for Cursor/VS Code/Codex etc. and Claude Code PostToolUse hooks; a code-review-graph-vscode extension ships in the repo.

reader2.note: `install` registers MCP with many platforms and writes Claude Code hooks (PostToolUse) and git pre-commit hook.

reader1.note: Registry of repos by path/alias with cross_repo_search over selected repos.

reader2.note: register/unregister/repos commands and cross_repo_search over registered repos.

reader1.note: git diff change discovery plus nodes.file_hash comparison so only changed and impacted files are re-parsed.

reader2.note: Compares stored file hashes and git diff to re-parse only changed files.

reader1.note: watch command uses a filesystem watcher with debounce; a daemon supervises multiple repos.

reader2.note: `watch` uses watchdog to auto-update on file changes; `daemon` supervises watchers.

reader1.note: Reads .code-review-graphignore plus DEFAULT_IGNORE_PATTERNS and nested build-output detection.

reader2.note: Default ignore globs, .gitignore and .code-review-graphignore with negation honoured during collection.

reader1.note: Writes JSON, GraphML, Neo4j Cypher, Obsidian markdown and SVG.

reader2.note: Exports JSON, GraphML, Neo4j Cypher, Obsidian vault and SVG; also wiki markdown.

reader1.note: Emits interactive d3 HTML and SVG for nodes and edges.

reader2.note: Generates interactive D3 HTML graph and SVG.

reader1.note: BFS over incoming edges from changed files/symbols to affected nodes within max_depth.

reader2.note: Walks edges backwards from changed files/symbols to a bounded set of impacted nodes.

reader1.note: Parses git diff hunks to line ranges, maps to nodes with risk scores, and builds review context with source and impact.

reader2.note: Parses git diff hunks to line ranges, maps to nodes, adds risk and review context with source snippets.

reader1.note: find_dead_code lists symbols without callers/importers/references; no import-cycle detection (grep cycle found only unrelated uses).

reader2.note: `dead-code` command lists functions/classes with no callers or test refs; no cycle report.

reader1.note: Per-node line-count size and a stored risk_index score are computed; no cyclomatic complexity or churn.

reader2.note: Node size (line span), per-file churn from git and a risk score; no cyclomatic complexity.

reader1.note: get_review_context assembles changed-symbol source, callers/impact and related nodes under node, edge and source-line budgets (max_lines_per_file, shared region budget).

reader2.note: get_review_context returns subgraph, source snippets and callers bounded by max_lines/max_files and a shared line budget.
